INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_TAILOR_CHARACTER.car: A hand is not a pile of cards. It is a loom.
INDIGOTAILOR-INDIGO_TAILOR_CHARACTER.des:
A reclusive artisan of the Underdocks loom-houses, carrying twin-bladed iron shears larger than her own body.
She treats her hand as a living loom: cutting dead cards into dyed scraps, and stitching those scraps into her main cards along glowing seams.
